defs.def: your ability to remember things 记忆力；记性

ex.s: All the different hallways and rooms were too much to think about, let alone commit to memory.
ex.t: 所有的走廊和房间各不相同，多到让人难以想象，更别说记在心里。

ex.s: I find during the winter months, plants around the house can really lift your mood.” Several studies have backed this up and found that indoor plants can improve creativity, focus and memory.
ex.t: 我发现在冬季的几个月里，房子周围的植物真的能提振你的情绪。”多项研究证实了这一点，发现室内植物可以提高创造力、专注力和记忆力。

ex.s: Her childhood memory.
ex.t: 鼓励学生回答问题

ex.s: 50 Honorable Mentions：Judges will choose up to 50 honorable mention winners, who will each receive a T-shirt in memory of Earhart’s final flight.
ex.t: 50个荣誉提名奖：评委将选出最多50名荣誉提名获奖者，每人将获得一件纪念埃尔哈特最后一次飞行的T恤。

defs.def: the period of time that sb is able to remember events 记忆所及的时期；回忆所及的范围

ex.s: One idea is that sleep helps us strengthen new memories.
ex.t: 同样地，当人们几天不睡觉时，他们会生病。

ex.s: As I was looking at it, the lovely memory of that day came back to me.
ex.t: 当我看着它的时候，那天的美好回忆涌上心头。

defs.def: a thought of sth that you remember from the past 回忆；记忆

ex.s: It prevents memory from fading.
ex.t: 它防止记忆衰退。

ex.s: raised memory capacity
ex.t: 提升记忆容量。

ex.s: She has recovered her memory.
ex.t: 她恢复了记忆。

ex.s: Memory is sometimes a tricky thing.
ex.t: 记忆有时是一件难以捉摸的事。

ex.s: The processes take place to stop our brains becoming loaded with memories.
ex.t: 这些过程的目的是防止我们的大脑被记忆塞满。

ex.s: Influencing / Influenced mainly by Joy, most of Riley’s memories are happy ones.
ex.t: 主要受乐乐的影响，莱莉的大部分记忆是快乐的。

ex.s: Sadness wants to do her duty but by accident causes the loss of Riley’s happy core memories with Joy.
ex.t: 悲伤想履行她的职责，却意外导致莱莉的快乐核心记忆与乐乐一起丢失。

ex.s: Packing up my parents’ house felt like a massive goodbye — that bedroom, those memories, the feeling of safety and shelter I always felt there.
ex.t: 收拾父母家的房子感觉像一场盛大的告别——那间卧室、那些记忆、我在那里始终感到的安全和庇护。

ex.s: Memories of their 67-year life together would always make her smile.
ex.t: 对他们67年共同生活的回忆总会让她露出微笑。

ex.s: You’ll develop that painting muscle memory that only comes with repetition.
ex.t: 你会形成那种只有通过重复才能获得的绘画肌肉记忆。

ex.s: The rules that assign meaning lie not just inside our heads, but also outside, in society, in social memory, social conventions and social relations.
ex.t: 赋予意义的规则不仅存在于我们头脑内部，也存在于外部——在社会中，在社会记忆、社会惯例和社会关系中。

ex.s: Recalling the memories of the trips.
ex.t: 回忆旅途中的记忆。

ex.s: Her memory of her brother.
ex.t: 她对哥哥的回忆。

ex.s: This picture often brings back to me many happy memories of your high school days.
ex.t: 这张照片常常让我回想起你的高中时代的许多美好回忆。

ex.s: Worried about her, Joy and Sadness try to work together to ensure she gets her core memories back.
ex.t: 出于对她的担心，快乐和悲伤努力合作，确保她能找回自己的核心记忆。

defs.def: what is remembered about sb after they have died 对死者的记忆

ex.s: Researchers from the University of Leipzig in Germany gathered more than 1, 000 retired workers who were over age 75 and assessed the volunteers’ memory and thinking skills through a battery of tests.
ex.t: 德国莱比锡大学的研究人员召集了1000多名75岁以上的退休工人，通过一系列测试评估志愿者的记忆力和思维能力。

ex.s: Your cat will likely smell your face and store the smell in its memory and use it to recognize you in the future.
ex.t: 你的猫可能会闻到你的脸，并将气味存储在它的记忆中，并在将来用它来识别你。

ex.s: To share a precious memory.
ex.t: 分享一段珍贵的记忆。

ex.s: Their research also suggests how we may build lasting memories over time even though the synapses become thinner.
ex.t: 他们的研究也揭示了我们如何能在突触变细的情况下随着时间建立持久的记忆。

ex.s: I must have always known reading was very important because the first memories I have as a child deal with books． There was not one night that I don't remember mom reading me a storybook by my bedside． I was extremely inspired by the elegant way the words sounded．
ex.t: 我一定一直都知道阅读非常重要，因为我童年最早的记忆都与书有关。没有哪个夜晚我不记得妈妈在床边给我读故事书。那些文字优雅的读音极大地启发了我。

ex.s: Then, in the 1980s, Bob Johnson created the life story model of identity, in which he proposes that, as we go through life, these core features are built in with our memories to create a personal story through which we understand our lives.
ex.t: 之后，在1980年代，鲍勃·约翰逊创立了身份的人生故事模型，他在模型中提出，在我们经历生命时，这些核心特征与我们的记忆一起构建，以创造一个个人故事，我们通过这个故事来理解我们的生活。

ex.s: People often link their memory of what they’ve read to how far into the book it was or where it was on the page.
ex.t: 人们常把对所读内容的记忆与它出现在书中的位置或页面上的位置联系起来。

ex.s: Bring back lost memories.
ex.t: 唤回失去的记忆。

ex.s: As the song goes, this long and winding road "will never disappear", and it will always stick in the visitor's memory.
ex.t: 正如歌中所唱，这条漫长而蜿蜒的道路“永远不会消失”，它将永远留在游客的记忆中。

ex.s: It’s as if the brain is preserving its most important memories.
ex.t: 就好像大脑在保存它最重要的记忆。

ex.s: Indeed, when it comes to environmental transformations, we can develop a form of collective “poor memory”, and each new generation can believe the state of affairs they encounter is nothing out of the ordinary.
ex.t: 的确，在环境变化方面，我们会产生一种集体的"健忘"，每一代新人都可能认为他们所遇到的事态再正常不过。

ex.s: They are held in memory of Qu Yuan, a poet and statesman in Ancient China.
ex.t: 它们是为了纪念屈原，一位中国古代的诗人和政治家。
